text: Edlan Halsing is a human located at Champion's Hall in Stormwind City. He sells Bloodthirsty Gladiator set items in exchange for Mark of Honor, and previously sold honor trade goods.
Eeryven Grayer is a dwarf flight Master located at The Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

Efrina was a human paladin of the Tyr's Guard and the sister of Duvall. At the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Efrina followed their leader Travard to Dalaran to seek help, but with the ongoing invasion, no one wanted to come to their aid. When a champion of the Light was sent by Lord Maxwell Tyrosus to find them, Travard ordered Efrina to stay at the Magical Menagerie with his steed Dawnbreaker. Later, Efrina followed Travard and the Argent Crusade forces to kill the cultists of the Twilight's Hammer at Tyr's Fall. When they entered the tomb, the group discovered abominations of the void and had to eliminate them before Travard could begin the ritual to claim the hammer. A

Elaine Trias is a human cheese vendor located in the Trade District of Stormwind City. She is most likely the wife of Elling Trias and the mother of Ben Trias. She can be found behind the counter in the family shop Trias' Cheese in the Trade District. When Stormwind was under a lockdown, Elaine greeted Shadow of the Uncrowned.
Eldara Dawnrunner is a blood elf located at the Shattered Sun Staging Area on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

Eidre was a human mage student of Dalaran and former fiancée of Alodi, who lived more than 2,600 years ago before the First War. Her parents owned some land by Brightwater Lake. Her family approved of her engagement with Alodi in the hopes that their marriage would bring more magic into their family that they could use to grow crops and further their land's prosperity. After Alodi became involved with Council of Tirisfal, his new duties to the secret Council strained their relationship. She grew distressed when her mother, her land, and her people were being plagued by the demon Kathra'natir and caused her father's death. Having to leave Dalaran to look after the family lands and estate as t
Egrigos was a blue dragon who was killed in a magical accident. His name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Elfarran is a night elf located in the War Room of Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. She serves as a battlemaster for Warsong Gulch.
Elly Langston is a human drink vendor located in the Pig and Whistle Tavern in the Old Town within Stormwind City.

Eli Thunderstrike is a Wildhammer dwarf who lives in Wildhammer Stronghold, in Outland's Shadowmoon Valley. Thunderstrike is the keeper of Sky'ree, the legendary gryphon of the equally-legendary gryphon rider Kurdran Wildhammer. Thunderstrike tends to the gryphon while Kurdran tends to business at the Stronghold.
Elise Brightletter is a dwarf inscription trainer found inside the shop Thistlefuzz Arcanery, by the flightpath in Ironforge.

Elenna Edune is a night elf found at the House of Edune in Ashenvale. Here she lives along with her family, William Dunadaire and Sulan Dunadaire. Elenna has a pet bird named Goodie. Elenna and her pet wander the clearing most of the time — briefly stopping at the cottage once in a while.
Elgin Baelor is a dwarf gryphon flight master located at Slabchisel's Survey in the Wetlands.

Ellendra Palescorn is a blood elf located at the Shrine of Two Moons. She accompanies Lor'themar Theron to Pandaria, to whom she appears to act as a bodyguard. She first appears during the quest Rise Of An Empire, where she (along with Lor'themar, Garrosh Hellscream, and Garrosh's own bodyguard Malkorok) will phase in for its duration. She later appears in Kun-Lai Summit following the mogu ambush and is present at Garrosh'ar Advance during the quest Memory Wine (quest).
Elizabeth is a human child located at the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Eliara Duskwing is a blood elf flight master located in the Horde camp in Xibala in Zuldazar.
Elyssia Winterdusk is a night elf flight master located in Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
Elric Whalgrene is a human located at Whalgrene's Lab in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. Due to his extraordinary abilities with potions, he is described as a wizard.
Elton Campbell is a human priest trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.
Emi Brunet is a night elf baby located at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Emilia Baumoon is a blood elf found in the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
Emily Fairweather is a human located at Fairweather's Fine Enchantments in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. Emily magicked up some bracers for a Boralus' guard.
Empowered Fireball is a mage talent that increases the damage of Fireball.
Empowered Renew is a Holy priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Rapid Recovery.

Emperor Tian was a mogu emperor who was considered monstrous. He is best known for using the powers of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to mold a group of cave troggs into a new messengers and deliverymen: the grummles.

Emperor Kang was a mogu emperor of the past whose reign was short. He wanted to bind Quilen servants in small stone statues, but this caused them to become greatly diminished in power, causing them to be deemed unworthy, and thus the project was abandoned.

Emissary Auldbridge is a human member of the Kirin Tor located just outside the Chamber of the Guardian in the center of Dalaran. He welcomes adventurers who have just arrived on the Broken Isles after Dalaran's teleportation, before walking away to the Violet Citadel, saying that he has to attend to other visitors.

Emperor Korthek is the self-proclaimed ruler of the Faithless sethrak. He was once one of the Keepers entrusted to protect Mythrax the Unraveler's tomb of Atul'Aman, and he and Keeper Vorrik co-ruled the sethrak. However, Korthek eventually grew powerhungry, created the Faithless, declared himself emperor, and allied with General Jakra'zet in an effort to resurrect Mythrax and use him to conquer all of Zandalar.
Enchanter Aeldron is a blood elf located in the Seer's Library in the neutral Shattrath City.
Enchantress Metura is a blood elf located in the Seer's Library in the neutral Shattrath City.
Enchanter Salias is a blood elf located in the Seer's Library in Shattrath City.
Enchantress Andiala is a blood elf enchanting trainer and vendor located on Scryer's Tier in the neutral Shattrath City. She is inaccessible to those allied with the Aldor.
Ensign Wallace is a human flight master located in Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.

Eranikus was a green dragon of the green dragonflight, consort to Ysera and was among the greatest of the green dragons. Ysera gave him the task of guarding the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows. However, Eranikus went insane not long after he entered the temple, one of the first dragons to succumb to the Nightmare's corruption. Since then the trolls in the temple have dispatched a group to Zul'Gurub, and succeeded in summoning Hakkar into the world. Of all the green dragons, only Ysera herself was stronger than Eranikus. The green wyrm eventually sacrificed himself to help Malfurion Stormrage and Tyrande Whisperwind in the War Against the Nightmare, redeeming himself in death.
Envoy Ragda was an orc Twin Peaks battlemaster located in the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Twin Peaks.
Erika Tate is a human cooking vendor located in the Pig and Whistle Tavern in the Old Town in Stormwind City.

Erol Evenworth was a dwarven weaponsmith, and a member of the Knights of the Silver Hand. He created Hellslayer Waraxes intending them to be used as weapons to use against the Lich King's undead forces. The Lich King learned of Evensworth's efforts, however, and sent spectral assassins to destroy him and burn down his smithy. A number of these waraxes survived the carnage.
Erich Lohan is a human found walking around the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City telling people to visit the Blue Recluse for "free drinks!".

Esara Verrinde is a blood elven member of the Magisters and the Tirisgarde. She is a fire mage and also proficient with a blade. Her family was killed by the Burning Legion. She becomes a champion of the Conjuror of the Tirisgarde and will remain near the sick Meryl and Khadgar. She can be gained by completing the Mage campaign. You gain her by going to an exotic magic society.
Eryna is a red dragon perched on a tower outside the entrance to Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands. She is disguised as a blood elf and spies on the twilight dragonflight.

Eriadnar is a night elf Sentinel who served under Commander Anaris Windwood in Ashenvale prior to the start of the War of the Thorns. She was among the Sentinels who were out on patrol with Anaris when the two Horde rogues Rifen and Lorash Sunbeam attacked and killed Anaris. Lorash fled, but Eriadnar sliced Rifen across the torso and lopped off one of his arms with her sword, allowing Ferryn to pin him to the ground. Eriadnar quietly told Delaryn Summermoon that she was now the commander in Anaris' stead. After interrogating the dying Rifen and realizing that the Horde was clearing a path through Ashenvale to invade Darnassus, Delaryn ordered Eriadnar to run to the night elf capital as fast
Erika Saka is a human located in Old Town in Stormwind City. She is speaking with Sojurn Saka.
Evan Larson is a human hat vendor located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Eva Dendra is a human found swimming around an island hut off the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit. She is watched by Mei Laoshi, a swimming instructor.
Evan-son Hipsbrew is the Alliance monk leader in Stormshield Stronghold on Ashran. He offers to teleport players to the location of their current party leader.

Ethel Siltsift is a human located at Saldean's Farm in Westfall. She can be seen repairing one of the broken fences. She was one of the Defias who remained loyal to Vanessa VanCleef even after the organization was turned against her by Duncon Ratsbon and Count Clessington, as she joined the organization to help the people of Westfall and not to plunder them. When Vanessa asked them to go home, she and the others thanked her one last time for all she had done for them, before heading back to Moonbrook. Following the defeat of Clessington and Duncon at Northshire Valley, she and the others joined the Breadbasket Guild in order to restore Westfall and help once more its inhabitants.
Evocation is an Arcane mage talent. It is a channeled spell that greatly increases the caster's mana regeneration.
Everyday Merchandise is a general and trade goods shop located in the Trade District in Stormwind City.
Executioner Gore is an elite orc boss found in the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.

Falcon Watch is a Horde-aligned blood elf settlement in the western area of the Hellfire Peninsula. Its current leader is Ranger Captain Venn'ren. There are several quest givers and vendors here, as well as a flight master and an innkeeper.
Faldorf Bitterchill is a frost dwarf flight master located at Frosthold in the Storm Peaks.

Faldren Tillsdale is a human valorous quartermaster located in the Command Center in Stormwind City. He originally sold his items for Valor Points, then in patch 5.0.4 he began charging Justice Points instead. With the removal of both point types in patch 6.0.2, he now sells most of his items for gold.

Fala Fizzlesprocket is a character in the story A Very Smokywood Winter Veil told by Wulmort Jinglepocket during the Smokywood Storytime. She has a robot pet called Bolts. In the story Fala is a young gnome who visited a Greatfather Winter Krizz and she wished father returned home. Eventually she followed Krizz and noticed him speaking with a dwarf who spoke with her father before he disappeared. She joined to the goblin Krizz and together they discover a Dark Iron plot against Ironforge. The dark irons had abducted Fala's father Fritz, and were using his abilities as a tinker to create a gigantic robot. As Krizz attacked the dwarves a group of another dwarves circled Fala. She used Reindeer

Faeyrine Springsong is a night elf druid of the Cenarion Circle living in the city of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. She is an old friend of a fellow druid named Thalyss Greyoak. Some time after the Cataclysm, the dying Thalyss asked a human boy named Aramar Thorne to deliver his pouch of seeds to her. Aram agreed to fulfill his last wish.

Fanny McLumpkins is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. She is one of the inhabitants of Wintergarde Village saved by the player during Flight of the Wintergarde Defender; therefore, she can be found at the keep only after the completion of this quest. She is wearing a Lovely Blue Dress. She is probably related to Ordal McLumpkins.
Falling Stars is a level 100 mage talent that changes based on the mage's specialization.
Fariel Starsong is a night elf member of the Cenarion Circle located in Nighthaven in Moonglade during Lunar Festival events.
Faralorn is a night elf general goods vendor located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Farmer Kalaba was a level 25 human found near Hillsbrad Fields in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She staged an ambush of undead supplies from the Undercity. High Executor Darthalia wanted Kalaba killed in revenge.
Farstad Stonegrip is a Wildhammer dwarf flight master located at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

Farmer Wollerton is a human farmer residing at the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City. Previously, a group of Twilight's Hammer cultists performed twisted rituals close to his home involving his cows. They were, however, stopped by Anduin Wrynn and the Alliance adventurer.

Farseer Krogar is an orc far seer and member of the Earthen Ring at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar. He is the quest giver responsible for guiding players toward several of the Cataclysm campaigns, including Vashj'ir and Deepholm. Most of his quest can also be obtained through the Warchief's Command Board. He appears to be wielding a Titansteel Destroyer.

Farrol was a human rider who Danath Trollbane chose to take with him along with half of the military in Stormwind City to the Dark Portal. He was very young for he never participated in the Second War or fought an orc in his life. His dream was to kill his first orc, but he never got the opportunity. Shortly after arriving at the Dark Portal, he was thrown off his horse. Danath did not see him die for he closed his eyes, but his screams would haunt him forever.

Farmer Lok'lub is an orc located at the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He is originally from Nagrand on Draenor. He used to test his strength against the beasts. Farmer Lok'lub and Farmer Krella are found at Frostwall if the Barn is built. He brings the captured animals back to the garrison.
Farkigos was a blue dragon who was killed in a magical accident. His name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Father Lazarus is a Forsaken priest trainer located in the War Quarter in the Undercity.

Fayin Whisperleaf is a night elf grand master herbalism trainer located in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord. He's found to the right of the entrance to the Inn, not with the other trainers near the flight point. He's back a little and easy to miss.

Father Gustav is a powerful priest and an important member of the Argent Crusade. He is instrumental in the purging of Scourgeholme and the Breach and the subsequent establishment of Justice Keep at Crusaders' Pinnacle. Father Gustav is first seen in the Argent Vanguard, but after the player completes The Last Line Of Defense he will move to the Valley of Echoes in a hut near the Breach. He was present during Death Rising.
Father Brunet is a night elf located at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Fel Lord Garzan is a fel lord located in the Black City area of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
Fel Lord Volak is a fel lord located in the Black City area of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
Fel Lord Durkan is a fel lord located in the Black City area of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde).
Fel Lord Rakaz is a fel lord located in the Black City area of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance).
Fel Lord Dukaz is a fel lord located in the Black City area of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance).
Fel Lord Zarnoz is a fel lord located in the Black City area of the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance).
Felicia Maline is a human gryphon flight master located at Darkshire in Duskwood. She was also seen at Yrel's Watch on alternate Draenor.
Ferocity is a hunter talent, located on tier 4 of the Beast Mastery tree.

Fenella Darkvire is a Dark Iron dwarf and the daughter of the much-reviled Dark Iron architect Fineous Darkvire, and, despite her father's reputation, one of Moira Thaurissan's premier architects. She is known for the construction of the Ruby Crystalarium in Shadowforge City.

Field Marshal Afrasiabi was a human field marshal located in the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City. He was a ranking member of the Stormwind Army and was the quest-end NPC for the Head of Nefarian, after speaking to Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep. He could be found standing under an arch, not far to the right of General Hammond Clay. During the Remembrance Day shortly after the Cataclysm, it was Afrasiabi's honor as a field marshal to introduce king Wrynn to begin his speech but the king was missing. Afrasiabi had to delay the crowd by speaking about what he knew the best - steam-engine siege tactics.

Fialla Sweetberry is a high elf food and drink vendor found outside One More Glass in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was cowering in fear. When the entire city was moved by a giant :Blink spell above Deadwind Pass, it caused a lot of troubles for the various citizens and their shops. Lucian Trias was upset because he though that half of his cheese had disappeared during the sudden transportation, and the idea that he could serve an abundance of wine and only mere crumbles of cheese was so preposterous to him that he felt faint afterwards. Meanwhile, Fialla was trying to calmly remind him that all the aged goods were actually properly stored before departure.
Field Marshal Chambers is a human that briefly appeared at the Argent Dawn encampment just east of Plaguewood in Eastern Plaguelands.

Fidelio Featherleaf is a night elf hippogryph master located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. After escaping the Burning of Teldrassil, he later participated in the Battle for Darkshore, opening up a flight path network for Alliance players with the assistance of Mordent Evenshade, who had them deliver Evenshade's Note to their commander Maiev Shadowsong.

Field Marshal Stonebridge is a human located under an arc in the northeastern Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City, not far to the right of General Hammond Clay (retail)/General Marcus Jonathan (Classic). She is the quest-end NPC for the Head of Nefarian.
Fiery Demise is a vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Fueled by Pain and Siphon Power traits.

Fineous Darkvire is a Dark Iron dwarf mini-boss found in Blackrock Depths. He was the Chief Architect of the Dark Iron dwarves in Shadowforge City. When his predecessor, the great architect Franclorn Forgewright, passed away, his hammer known as Ironfel was handed down to him. Darkvire died when Magni Bronzebeard sent a rescue team came to rescue his daughter Moira. The adventurers wrestled the hammer from Darkvire's grasp, and returned it to the Shrine of Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths by demand of Forgewright's ghost himself. They were bestowed with the Shadowforge Key in exchange for their assistance. His daughter, Fenella Darkvire, who does not share his bad reputation, is now one of the
Finnia Hawkshot is a human flight master located in Kennings Lodge in Tiragarde Sound.
First Mate Williams is a human that would appear in Stormwind City prior to the discovery of Pandaria.
First Mate McNally is a human located in Island Expeditions.
Flamecannon is a passive Fire mage PvP talent, briefly increasing their maximum health, damage output and attack range.
Flightmaster Krill Bitterhue is a dwarf gryphon master located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Flora Dreamwhisper is a night elf. She reuses the model of Erelyn Moonfang.
Flynn Firebrew is a dwarf found at Kharanos in Dun Morogh during Brewfest.
Forgus is a fel orc located at the Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley.

Forthisal D'Neve is a high elf rogue and one of the Third Fingers of the Stormwind Assassins. She is 37, with black hair and green eyes. Forthisal was born to wizards who died at Dalaran (probably during the Third War) while she fled south with the refugees. Seeing the futility of magic, she left the wizards and made her living on the streets, where she was recruited by the Stormwind Assassins. She became a proficient member with the skill to be at least a Second, or maybe a First Finger, but she decided to remain a Third so she could continue gathering information about the organizations Mathias Shaw sent her to investigate. Due to that, she is a unique experiment for the Assassins. While t

Frederick Stover is a level 30 human bow vendor located in his shop The Empty Quiver located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found behind the counter, just inside the shop. He is the royal bowyer of House of Wrynn. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind.
Fragrant Frena is a blood elf rogue located at the Mugambala in Zuldazar. She is dueling with "The Immortal" Wren‎.

Frostwolf Ambassador Rokhstrom is an orc located in the Barracks in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, she was located in the Valley of Strength. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

Gaedrin Moonfang was one of the first Druids of the Pack, who kept his night elf mind longer than most of his comrades, and wrote the Faded Journal, which worgen players came across in the starting quests.
Fyranian is a black dragon flying around the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
Galthuk is an orc two handed weapons vendor located in the Valley of Honor in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.

Gakkorg is a young orc formerly affiliated with the Kor'kron, who served under both Thrall and Garrosh Hellscream. During the latter's reign, Gakkorg's task was to take care of Magnataur younglings in Bilgewater Harbor, where he did his best to try and make the captivity as humane as possible. He left the organization in disgust after Garrosh released the young to die on the Shattered Strand following their parents' deaths in the battle of Ashenvale, earning a bounty on his head that he successfully avoided. After the Garrosh's capture he acted as the eighth witness telling the fate of the younglings.
Gai Plin is a monk who extracted the healing powers of the Ru'shan River and used it to infuse a belt with soothing sensations.

Gargok is an orc Warsong Gulch battlemaster found at the Mor'shan Base Camp of the Northern Barrens. He appears to be the leader of the Warsong Outriders, as he represents them during the ceremony at the Undercity.

Garno was an orc warrior and a childhood friend of Broxigar, to the point where the two were practically like brothers. While holding a mountain pass against the Burning Legion during the Battle of Mount Hyjal, Garno was hacked into pieces by a fiery, horned demon. Moments later, Brox avenged him by cleaving his killer in half.
Gardener Flin is a human located at the Wollerton Stead in Stormwind City. She is watching after William Henry and Lilian Mae, turning to follow them as they run around the farm.
Garo Driftpelt is a Mag'har orc located in island expeditions.

Gaskal was an orc that was sent by Thrall, along with the veteran warrior Broxigar, shortly after the Third War to investigate an anomaly that Kalthar had located using his shaman abilities. He and Brox soon located the anomaly, but were caught by it. He was torn apart by the mystical energy of it, while Broxigar lived and was transported into the past.

Garshilan is an adult male red dragon stationed at Grim Batol following the Battle of Grim Batol. He is charged with leading the red dragonspawn patrolling the region. This draconic warrior-mage is assisted in his duties by the members of the red flight under his command, such as the ambitious young red dragon Acridistrasz and the dragonspawn flametongue Baleflame.

Garthin Stoneguider was a dwarf residing in Menethil Harbor, during the time of the war against the Lich King. He was a friend to Marcus Windthorne and met the draenei Iridi and accompanied her while she was there. After she learned that she will have to stay in the harbor, a group of raptors attacked the town. Garthin immediately went to battle them and insisted on Iridi to stay safe. She followed him though and the dwarf took her to a secret passageway. There she magically made him unconscious, assured he was all right and left him in the tunnel.

Gazin Tenorm is a dwarf located in the Cathedral of Light in the human capital of Stormwind City. He can be found at the back of the cathedral, near the altar. Together with his friend Henze Faulk, they were investigating the presence of the Defias Brotherhood in the region in order to provide proof to the king's advisors. He had an encounter with some Defias forces in Elwynn Forest and barely escaped with his life. Worried about his friend, he sent a young paladin, sent by his friend Duthorian Rall, to save him.
Geenia Sunshadow is a night elf robe vendor located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.

General Drakkisath was the black dragonspawn ruler of the dragonspawn armies of Nefarian, son of Deathwing. From the pinnacle of Upper Blackrock Spire, he oversaw his forces in their war to drive out the Dark Iron dwarves from the bowels of Blackrock Mountain. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire. His personal weapon was Blackblade of Shahram, which could be looted on his body.
Georgio Bolero is a human artisan tailoring trainer located in the shop Duncan's Textiles in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Gerik Koen is a human two handed weapon vendor located in Heavy Handed Weapons in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Gest is an orc rogue trainer located in the Shadowswift Brotherhood in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar. Gest was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar, initially standing next to Ormok.

General Lordenson is the commander of the warriors of Nethergarde Keep. Lordenson, along with Archmage Thas'ranan, share leadership of Nethergarde. They are rarely at odds, but when they are, the other inhabitants make themselves scarce as the sparks fly.

General Arlos is a high ranking commander in the Valiance Expedition, that fell to the Cult of the Damned's trickery. While there is little description of his personality, according to Harbinger Vurenn, his words rung unsure; as if they were not actually coming from him. This turned out to be true, as it was later revealed he was being magically manipulated by Prince Valanar who was posing as Counselor Talbot.

Gennet was a human warrior, who fled from a demon attack. While fleeing, he found an unlikely band of adventurers by a "temple of a forgotten god" and decided to join them in their quest for treasures and power.
Gertrude Fenlow is a human located near the gates of Stormwind City in Elwynn Forest.

General Hammond Clay is the successor of the late General Marcus Jonathan as commander of the defense of Stormwind City, following Jonathan's death during the Attack on Theramore Isle. He can be found at the end of the Valley of Heroes, in front of the statue of Turalyon. He also shows up with High Sorcerer Andromath and Maginor Dumas to arrest Hogger, as did his predecessor.

Gerok is an orc located at the Kelp'thar Forest. He in one of the survivors the Horde encounters on its way. He is briefly seen being attacked by Ozumat and thrown in the air during the quest Call of Duty (Horde).
Geoff is a human child walking with Miss Danna all around Stormwind City.
Gerald Black is a human located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.

Gerithus is a green dragon in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is the son of Merithra and the grandson of the former Dragon Aspect Ysera. Along with Solethus, Gerithus flies with Merithra to answer the call of the Horn of Drusahl after it is blown by Balakar Khan and Koroleth. When the Nokhud try to kill Merithra with a bolt from a dragonkiller ballista, Gerithus and Solethus fly in front of her to absorb the bolt. Solethus is the one hit and plummets to the Watering Hole. Khanam Matra Sarest and an adventurer seek the dragons out and explain that they are on the dragons' side. Gerithus, who is upset by Solethus' death and less trusting than his mother, says that he'll continue to keep an eye on the

Gerget Hardhands is a human located at Saldean's Farm in Westfall. He can be seen working the fields with a hoe. He was one of the Defias who remained loyal to Vanessa VanCleef even after the organization was turned against her by Duncon Ratsbon and Count Clessington, as he joined the organization to help the people of Westfall and not to plunder them. When Vanessa asked them to go home, he and the others thanked her one last time for all she had done for them, before heading back to Moonbrook. Following the defeat of Clessington and Duncon at Northshire Valley, he and the others joined the Breadbasket Guild in order to restore Westfall and help once more its inhabitants.
Gilda Silvershield is a dwarf paladin trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.
Ginny Goodwin is a human flight master at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. After the Alliance retreated, she didn't escape with them. Her corpse lies on the path by the inn.

Gonto is an orc mining trainer located inside Naros' Armory in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He can be seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, he was speaking with Lutah.
Gondar is an orc located in the building just southeast of the destroyed Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.

Gordie is a human child found in Shattrath City. When players turn in Of Thistleheads and Eggs... he says: "It's a complete and total barf-o-rama! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!" Which is a reference to Stand by Me. Wil Wheaton's character Gordie tells a story about a pie eating contest that ends in a chain reaction of vomit.

Goram is an orc guild vendor found in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. He was also present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

Gorfax Angerfang is an orc warrior and the current chieftain of the Dragonmaw clan. He is initially found in the Wetlands at the Angerfang Encampment. There, he is described to be the chieftain of the Angerfang Dragonmaw. In the Wetlands, he took Nek'rosh Skullcrusher's position as a leader in the area. He later took control of the clan after the death of Warlord Zaela, as he represents the Dragonmaw at the prestige ceremony in the Undercity. This is later repeated at the Kosh'harg festival, where it is definitively stated he is the chieftain. Unlike those that came before him, he seeks to bring the Dragonmaw back to an honorable future; rather than one laiden with subjugation and slavery.
Gorek is an orc located at the Talrendis Point in Azshara. He was sent behind enemy lines to destroy the towers, so the wind riders won't be taken down. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Gorabosh is an orc located at the Bleeding Hollow Hunting Grounds‎ in Tanaan Jungle. He is a user of blood magic.
Gordon MacKellar is a human located at the Pyrotechnics shop in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City.
Good Karma is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Power of a Thousand Cranes and Rising Winds traits.
Gorkas is an orc flight master located at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. He spends most of his time fishing off the pier.

Gorkrak is an orc member of the Twilight's Hammer. His skin was pale green, with piggy eyes. He led an attack on the druid summit in Ashenvale some time prior to the Cataclysm. The druid summit was meant to reduce the rising tensions between the Horde and the Alliance, following the murder and skinning of a group of Sentinels in Ashenvale. Hamuul Runetotem was the only survivor of the attack, finding himself in a mass grave after being knocked out. During the Fourth War, he worked alongside remnants of the Twilight's Hammer operating within Blackfathom Deeps who were harvesting :Azerite from the planet. They were encountered by Alliance and Horde champions.

Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth is the commander of the Stormwind fleet and the Alliance navy. She has been directly involved in numerous operations of paramount importance to Stormwind and the Alliance. She is located in the throne room of Stormwind Keep, in the city of Stormwind.

Grand Magus Telestra is a high elf boss inside the Nexus. She is one of the mages of the Kirin Tor who has sided with Malygos to retain her arcane powers. Currently, she is guarding one part of Keristrasza's prison. She is also the leader of the effort to redirect the ley lines in the Dragonblight.
Grand Marauder Sai is a human located at the Silver Enclave in Dalaran. Sai wears the Tier 2 Set Bloodfang and wields Ancient Qiraji Ripper and Maladath, Runed Blade of the Black Flight

Grand Magus Doane is the human guise of the black dragon Darkblaze. He is initially located in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains but later comes outside for the final confrontation with John J. Keeshan. Inside the tower, he will summon an abomination. Though he is not a tough fight, this should be kept in mind when engaging him.

Grand Empress Zek'hara was a ruler of the mantid before Shek'zeer, though how long before is unknown. Obsessed with control and gripped by paranoia, she aspired to stay in power long past her time. She masked her true intentions behind the guise of matronly worry, claiming her overbearing ways were necessary to protect the mantid. To achieve her goal, she was even willing to sacrifice the eternal cycle of her race. When she tried to forbid the swarm, to prevent "a senseless loss of life", the Klaxxi, most notably Hisek the Swarmkeeper, had no choice but to end her.
Grand Master Ulrich is a human located on the expedition islands.

Gregory Ardus is a human located in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. He is the proprietor of the ironically-named 'Just Maces', in which he can be found. He is located behind the counter of the shop.

Gregor is a medicine man with the Dragonmaw clan of orcs, located at Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands. Gregor was antsy due to his clans tumultuous history, but had alot of faith in the young Zaela. Horde adventurers enlisted his aid in healing the surviving troops after the Horde warfleet was decimated on arrival in the Highlands by attacks from the twilight dragonflight and the Alliance. His apprehension to help stems from fear of Warchief Mor'ghor. Gregor was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was accompanied by Gralok. At the festival, Gregor hoped that Dragonmaw orcs could find their place and that strife between orcs would finally end.
Grim Perseverance is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Skeletal Shattering and Vampiric Fangs traits.
Gringer is an orc flight master located at Kalimdor Airlines in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Grimly Singefeather is a Dark Iron dwarf flight master located at Chiselgrip in the Burning Steppes.
Grinslicer is an orc flight master located at Beastwatch in Gorgrond. He stands next to a Laughing Ravager.

Grimbak Shadowrage was a fel orc captain of the Shadowmoon clan who served Illidan Stormrage in Outland. He accompanied his lord to Auchindoun to gather souls in order to open a portal to Argus. Grimbak protected Illidan while he channeled the souls into his soul siphon, but was killed by the draenei ghosts defending the ruined mausoleum.
Grizzle Halfmane was an orc Alterac Valley battlemaster located in the Royal Quarter in the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Alterac Valley.
Grisha is an orc flight master located at Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge.

Griselda Hunderland is a human human plate armor vendor found in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was cowering in fear and crying in a corner of the second floor. She was present in the city when it appeared above Deadwind Pass. She is not present when Dalaran is above the Broken Isles.
Grunt Grimful is an orc grunt located in the Auction House in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, he used to be an auctioneer. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Grunt Wabang is an orc grunt located in the Auction House in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, he used to be an auctioneer. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.

Grunt Karus is an orc grunt located in the Bank of Orgrimmar in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Along with his brothers, Koma and Soran, Karus claims to have fought at the Battle of Mount Hyjal. After the failed Broken Shore attack, he was seen speaking with Rilgiz in front of the bank. After the death of Warchief Vol'jin, he is seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt who was lamenting whether Vol'jin's poison made him name Sylvanas the Warchief.

Grunt Soran is an orc grunt located in the Bank of Orgrimmar in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Along with his brothers, Koma and Karus, Soran claims to have fought at the Battle of Mount Hyjal. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's funeral, he was speaking with Perixa.
Grunt Korf is an orc located in the Hall of Legends in the orc city of Orgrimmar.
Grothok Blackcrag was an orc located at the Silken Shore in the Jade Forest. He led the charge on Wayward Landing. As his title indicated, he was captain of a destroyer, and also led Horde Seadogs.
Grunt Meena is an orc grunt located on the top floor of the Broken Tusk in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. She is sitting with her friend Gamon, the Hero of Orgrimmar.
Grunt Nolo is an orc grunt located at the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
Grotto Terrapin is a dragon turtle located in Island Expeditions.

Gubber Blump is a dwarf fishing trainer located in Auberdine in Darkshore. He stood on the beach, between the flight master and the dock. Gubber enjoyed fishing and the culinary aspects of crab meat. Graun Blump was a cousin of Gubber; it was maintained by Gubber that she has a beard and smells unusual. After the Cataclysm, Gubber is nowhere to be seen and isn't mentioned in any Darkshore quests.
Gryphoneer Windbellow is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Shatter Point in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Gryphonrider Kieran is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Wildhammer Stronghold in the Shadowmoon Valley.
Gug is a fel orc armor vendor located at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. Gug is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.
Guard Hammon is a human guard located in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City.
Guard Quine is a human guard located in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City.
Gryphonrider Nordin is a Wildhammer dwarf located at the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley.

Gunnar Flyntrock was the leader of a group of Dark Iron dwarves. When Thargas Anvilmar, Varian "Lo'Gosh" Wrynn, Valeera Sanguinar and Broll Bearmantle were travelling through the Wetlands they were attacked by Gunmar and his dark iron dwarves. After a fierce battle, Gunnar's troops were defeated. Before his death, he said that Thargas's brother, Hjalmar Anvilmar was captured by the dark iron dwarves in Thandol Span. Thus, the four companions decided to rescue Hjalmar and go to Thandol Span.
Guldros Onyxbrand is a Dark Iron dwarf located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
Gyll is a dwarf gryphon flight master found at the Southern Skies Platform in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Guthrum Thunderfist is a dwarf gryphon flight master located at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
Gursha is a Mag'har orc flight master located at Garadar in Nagrand.
Gurric is an orc flight master located at The Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

Halduron Brightwing is the Ranger-general of Silvermoon—the military leader of Quel'Thalas and high commander of its defenses—and the leader of the Farstriders, succeeding the fallen Sylvanas Windrunner in both roles. Halduron is the long-time best friend of the Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas, Lor'themar Theron, under whom Halduron has served since the rise of the blood elves. Halduron is Lor'themar's most loyal and trusted comrade, and has served Quel'Thalas with unwavering courage and integrity. He is the regent lord's primary confidant, and one of his chief advisors alongside Grand Magister Rommath.
Hagrus is an orc reagent vendor located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar.

Commander Haldrissa Woodshaper was a night elf Sentinel. She was the commander of the night elf forces protecting Ashenvale, promoted to the post just before the Cataclysm. She had been a Sentinel since nearly the creation of the organization. She is said to had fought with Tyrande over millennia and that Ashenvale is her true home, rather than the newer Darnassus. She was actually some centuries older than General Shandris Feathermoon, but recognized the general's skills and eagerly learned all she could, resulting in her promotions within the army. When the Horde begun their launch over Ashenvale she has been trying to send word to Darnassus of the Horde's increased activity there. She los
Hailia Moonfeather is a night elf found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Hamaka is an orc bartender of the Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within the mage city of Dalaran.
Hans Shuffleshoe is a dwarf in the Chamber of Enlightenment in the Shrine of Seven Stars. A K'thir Darkspeaker has disguised itself as him in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Hanlir is a blood elf mining trainer and vendor located on the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City. He does not offer his services to those allied with the Aldor.
Hans Coldhearth is a human ice cream vendor and member of the Cone of Cold located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City during Children's Week.
Harry Burlguard is a human located in the Pig and Whistle Tavern in the Old Town of Stormwind City.
Haren Kanmae is a human bow vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn where he runs Swift Flights.
Harklane is a night elf fish and drink vendor located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Hardigan Ironjaw is an Ironforge dwarf of the Explorers' Guild and was part of the Thor Modan expedition. The Guild thought it was a good idea to send him to Northrend. Hardigan believed he could find evidence of his race's ancestors in the hills, and uncover truths about their early culture. He believes the Titans placed dwarves in Northrend, after they'd finished creating them. It was an experiment to see if they could survive on their own. The dwarves not only survived but flourished, spreading southward and into what would later become Kalimdor and the other continents.

Hargin Mundar is a dwarf found in the tavern at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He seems to be content spending his days in the Deepwater Tavern getting drunk. While he was in Ironforge, he put a floodgate in the city and ended up trapping himself before being tunneled from the channel straight into the dining hall. He views this event as an honest mistake and mentions that the ale was safe.

Harold Atkey is a human barkeeper located at the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He sells only typical strength alcoholic beverages and no strong drinks. He seems to be quite bored because his tavern rarely sees any customers.
Hardened Snapjaw is a dragon turtle located in Island Expeditions.

Hatecoil Spirit is a naga spirit located in Azsuna. She is summoned by Hatecoil Spearhead. She uses water and frost abilities. Once killed, the water around her can be fished for Fragmented Enchantment.
Healthy Appetite is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Potent Kick, Dark Side of the Moon (monk artifact trait) and Swift as a Coursing River traits.
Healing Winds is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Crosswinds, Strength of Xuen, and Tiger Claws traits.

Heather May is a human located at Saldean's Farm in Westfall. She can be seen inside the Saldean's home. She was one of the Defias who remained loyal to Vanessa VanCleef even after the organization was turned against her by Duncon Ratsbon and Count Clessington, as she joined the organization to help the people of Westfall and not to plunder them. When Vanessa asked them to go home, she and the others thanked her one last time for all she had done for them, before heading back to Moonbrook. Following the defeat of Clessington and Duncon at Northshire Valley, she and the others joined the Breadbasket Guild in order to restore Westfall and help once more its inhabitants.
Heinrich Stone is a human blade vendor located in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Helidan Lightwing is a high elf flight master for the Argent Tournament world event. He is located next to the stables in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising.
Helga Hammerdin is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor found at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.
Heroes' Earthshatter Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 7 restoration shaman set.
Heroes' Earthshatter Garb is the 10-man versions of the tier 7 elemental shaman set.
Heroes' Earthshatter Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 7 enhancement shaman set.
Hestia Strongbolt is a human flight master located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.

Hesthera is a green dragon initially found hovering in front of Viranikus at Merithra's Watch in the Ohn'ahran Plains. On Merithra's orders, they fly to join the battle at the Storm Scar alongside Viranikus, Berinus, and Fernarus. After the Primalists' defeat, Hesthera join the rest of the green dragon crowd around the Emerald Oathstone on the Ancient Bough.
Bardolan is a blood elf master enchanting trainer located on the Scryer's Tier in the Seer's Library in Shattrath City.
High Executor Yothrim is a human located at the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum next to the Ny'alotha, the Waking City entrance.

High Priestess Laurena is a human priestess and priest trainer located behind the altar in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. Based on her title, she is a high-ranking member of the Church of the Holy Light and appears to be in charge of the cathedral.

High Priest Rohan is a dwarf priest trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. He is the highest-ranking member of the Church of the Holy Light in the city, pacing back and forth within the Hall, and formerly the priest representative on the New Council of Tirisfal.

High Priest Amet is a Ramkahen tol'vir and is apparently is the leader of the Ramkahen's religious sector called "The Faith of Ramkahen". As such, he is also the sector's representative in the "The High Council", the ruling authority of the Ramkahen under King Phaoris. Having the ability to read the future in the Vir'naal Lake's waters, he can be found inside the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum where he is looking at the water through a window. He there acts as a quest giver. He is accompanied by two Vir'Naal Priests. During the Assault in Uldum, he is found back in Ramkahen near the king. He also appears in the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
High Sorceress Marala is a human located in Valorcall Pass and the Mage Tower in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. She is riding a magical steed.
Hoboair is a human flight master located at Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.
Hoka Stonecrush is an orc trade goods vendor, serving in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons.

Historian Llore is a human member of the Timewalkers investigating the Timeless Isle alongside Kairoz. He is found at the Whispershade Hollow. During Warcraft's Anniversary, Llore could be found in the Royal Library in Stormwind City, acting as the Alliance counterpart to Historian Ju'pa. During WoW's 15th Anniversary, Llore and Ju'pa appeared in the Caverns of Time.

Horthus is an orc reagent vendor located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he could be found sitting with Shan'ti in a hut. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar. After the battle, he can be seen speaking with Shan'ti.

Horus is a fel orc general goods, meat, and drink vendor located at Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. Although he is called an "innkeeper", he will not let anyone set their hearthstone there. Horus is to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.
Hot Blooded is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Potent Kick, Dark Side of the Moon (monk artifact trait), Obsidian Fists and Face Palm (artifact trait) traits.

Hreggan Krakfist is an orc holy strider. One of Orgrimmar's few orc holy striders, Hreggan is charged with the important task of mapping Kalimdor and its surrounding islands. He looks for new settlement sites, charts the monsters or Alliance forces in the area, and makes sure Thrall's maps are correct. He returns to Orgrimmar every year and has a 3-day meeting alone with his leader to report his findings. Once he charts the entirety of Kalimdor, Thrall plans on sending him to chart Northrend to learn of the Lich King's activities.

Hugh Deepstone is an enterprising member of the Explorers' League. He specializes in strange and exotic creatures. The naga intrigue him especially, as they are all mutants, and naga anomalies hold great interest for him. Hugh started a catalogue of known naga anomalies, in order to keep track of their capabilities and share this information with the rest of the Explorers' League. No one has seen Hugh for several months, however, and the last anyone heard, his catalogue was up to three listings.

Huntress Leafrunner is a night elf huntress found patrolling the walkways of Darnassus. In Patch 10.2.5, she can be found at Bel'ameth, just west of the Terrace of the Moon, close to Shay Leafrunner and Rockbiter.

Huntsman Blake is the stylishly dressed hunter trainer found throughout Gilneas City and the rest of Gilneas. Following the conclusion of the worgen starting experience, he can be found along with several other trainers in the Howling Oak of Darnassus, where he continues to serve as a hunter trainer. His faithful tracking mastiff is Baron.

Huntress Nhemai is a night elf huntress, standing along the road which goes from Dolanaar to Darnassus, near the path leading to Ursal the Mauler's den. She accompanies Moon Priestess Amara and fellow huntress Yaeliura. Before Cataclysm she used to be on her nightsaber as the other two elves do, while now she is on foot, guarding the path behind them. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Huntress Yaeliura is a night elf huntress, standing along the road which goes from Dolanaar to Darnassus, near the path leading to Ursal the Mauler's den. She accompanies Moon Priestess Amara and fellow huntress Nhemai. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Hunter Akana is an experienced ankoan hunter located in Nazjatar. Born into a clan that was destroyed by the naga, he was forced to survive in the deep wilderness alone. Seeking vengeance for the deaths of his kin, he joined the Waveblade clan in their quest to defeat Queen Azshara.
Ildyri is a night elf Sentinel under Shandris Feathermoon. Ildyri was appointed to keep guard over the body of second murdered Highborne, Ha'srim.

Illiyana Moonblaze is a night elf pvp vendor located in Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. She is not a Sentinel, and it is mentioned that she "belonged to a group that was not exactly favored by most Sentinels". She is known for her roguish personality. As noted in pictures of her she wears a dark corseted outfit and wields a pair of longswords. She radiates a presence in some matter akin to a wild pirate. Although officially an officer, and therefore in a level of command, her unofficial duties and skills are actually the most important aspect of her service. One of these roles is scouting -- but it is only called that because there is a lack of a better term to describe it. She is also noted

Ilsa Corbin is a human warrior trainer located in the Command Center in Old Town in Stormwind City. During the Fourth War, Ilsa was encountered by the Horde at Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills when the Alliance attacked a Horde garrison at the mine.
Ilsa Blusterbrew is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon riding trainer located near the gryphon stables at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.
Ilustriel Greenleaf is a human mage. He started a group to help people understand the dangers of abusing magic.
Illidari Calia is a blood elf flight master located in Deliverance Point in Broken Shore.

Imindril Spearsong is a high elf blacksmith trainer and vendor in Dalaran. She teaches superior and epic Weaponsmith recipes to all players in the Weaponsmith profession path. When Dalaran relocated above Deadwind Pass and the Burning Legion invaded the city, she was seen fighting demons in the street.
Imelda is a human located in the Park district of Stormwind City, to the north of the well.

Improved Mind Blast is a priest talent that reduces Mind Blast's cooldown by 0.5 seconds per rank, for a maximum reduction of 1.5 seconds, leaving a 6.5 second cooldown. In addition it gives Mind Blast a 33% chance per rank to reduce all healing done to the target by 10% - up to a maximum 100% chance - while the priest is in Shadowform. Mind Blast, though one of few ways for a Shadow priest to deal burst DPS, is very mana inefficient compared to Mind Flay and DoTs. With that in mind, this talent is geared more toward PvP, where burst DPS is king - a shadow priest looking to maximize his sheer kill power in PvP will find this talent very useful. It's much less useful in PvE, however, where Mi
Improved Sweeping Strikes is an Arms warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Strength of Arms.

Increased Scrutiny is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from the following bosses: *The Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).
Injured Adept is a blood elf demon hunter located in Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
Insanity is a Shadow priest talent, available at level 45. The Discipline and Holy alternative is Power Word: Solace.
Innes Shieldshatter is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Inspector Valwynna is a human located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. She is inspecting the damages at the edge of the landing. The damage has been there since the city was over Deadwind Pass, though the fel glow may have been updated.

Instructor Duskwalker is a void elf located at Fathom's Edge in the Telogrus Rift. He is experienced in the ways of Void magic, and is charged with instructing new initiates in these ways. During the Fourth War, he was encountered in the Ruins of Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh by Horde champions.
Invocation is a mage talent available at level 90. It causes a loss in mana regeneration but increases the mage's spell damage for 40 seconds after successfully completing an Evocation channel.
Intolerance is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Dragon Skin, Shatter the Bones, Thunder Crash, and Wall of Steel traits.
Isaac Eppstein is a human located near Keri Reynolds in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He is found dead in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Jabbey is a goblin general goods vendors located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Like most residents of Steamwheedle Port, he has gone missing and possibly killed by the destructive wave that destroyed the port.

J'argg Bloodfyre was a Shadowmoon orc who lived on Draenor at the start of the genocide of the draenei. He became a leader of raids on the remaining draenei, and often urged his brother, Jaruk Bloodfyre, to drink the Blood of Mannoroth as well and join their slaughtering of man, woman and child alike. J'argg forced Jaruk to carry axes but they were ineffective in the shaman's hands. During a raid, he thought he saved Jaruk's life by killing two draenei. In truth however, Jaruk was trying to help the draenei escape. When he threw a spear into the second draenei, Alius, he learned that one draenei escaped. He ordered Ra'nok to burn the corpses and went for the draenei. He found her as she was
Ivanel Meadowsong is a night elf located at the Moonfall Approach in Suramar.
Jacob McWeaksauce is a human located in the Dragon Soul. He would offer teleportation to the various bosses being tested.
Jalane Ayrole is a human tailoring trainer found in the cellar of the Slaughtered Lamb pub in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Jah'Yani Sunscorch is a high elf diplomat in Theramore. She keeps her eyes clear and watches the tides of power in Theramore move among its races.

Jai'alator ("noble blade of Elune" in Darnassian) is the hippogryph of Shandris Feathermoon, general of the Sentinels. Jai'alator is described as "a large male hippogryph with a plumage more striking than other hippogryphs, darker and more dramatic feathers, as well as crimson lines across the ebony wings and slight turquoise markings on the upper edges. Crimson feathers also lined the otherwise blue-black head".
Jasper Fel is a human vendor located in SI:7 in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Janey Anship is a human mage who sits with Lisan Pierce and Suzanne at the base of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, having a discussion about creating a spell or potion. The three sometimes get up to walk along the canals and through the Trade District before returning to their original spot.
